name: How long does the stucco coating application process usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the stucco coating application process usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior stucco coating application depends on the size and complexity of the project. For an average-sized home, the process typically takes anywhere from a few days to a week. This includes essential preparation steps like cleaning, minor stucco repairs, and masking, followed by the application of primers and one or two coats of the chosen finish. Factors such as weather conditions, the number of coats required, and architectural details can also influence the overall timeline. We establish a clear project schedule with homeowners.
acceptedAnswer.description: The stucco coating application process typically takes a few days to a week for an average home, depending on size, complexity, preparation needed, and weather conditions.
